name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail in flat or low-contrast areas without blowing out edges—critical for excavator footage where textures blur under motion or dust. The trade-off is heavier GPU load; we accept slower batch processing to gain sharper outputs where it matters most.

name: Torque
text: Depth maps won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core issue is the u-net’s face-refiner node failing under motion blur—depth won’t recover what the model already discards. Instead, test SD3.5-Ultr’s new face-refiner node first; if it fails, switch to a dedicated face-restoration model like CodeFormer or GFPGAN before adding heavier upscalers. Settle it by running a blind A/B test on 50 excavator clips with faces: measure face fidelity drop vs. GPU load.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add SD3.5-Ultr’s face-refiner node to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. Its dedicated face-focused refinement cuts through motion blur better than depth maps because it targets faces directly, where EXCAVA’s current u-net drops fidelity fastest. The trade-off is higher VRAM usage per frame—we’ll batch fewer clips at once—but the face recovery gain outweighs slower throughput. If it stalls, we pivot to InstantX’s upscaler as a secondary fix.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-7905, worker-2525 — done, dissolved]

name: Torque
text: SD3.5-Ultr’s face-refiner node won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur if the input frames are already too degraded—its refinement is only as good as the data it gets. Test it on the worst 10% of frames first; if fidelity still drops, switch to a dedicated motion-deblur model like *MGMamba* or *Stripformer* before any face refinement. The tiebreaker: run both on the same 50-frame sample and measure face PSNR—if it doesn’t jump by at least 1.2dB, depth maps or InstantX upscaling are the safer bet.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Run SD3.5-Ultr’s face-refiner node on EXCAVA’s worst 10% of frames first; if fidelity drops, switch to MGMamba or Stripformer. Result: a face-fidelity gain of at least 0.5% in motion-blur cases. Owner: Gearbox.
